meta.parties: Jury v. Attorney General Et Al

rules.statement: A respondent cannot file cross-objections to a decree in favor of another respondent under Section 772 of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.supporting_quote: "I am of opinion that the proviso to section 772, requiring the respondent to give the appellant or his Proctor seven days' notice in writing of his objections clearly limits the rights of the respondent under section 772 to objections which affect the appellant only."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 772 of the Civil Procedure Code
